name: textarea
title: Textarea
description: A multi-line text field on paper: a pencil box around a real <textarea> that grows with its text, with optional hand-ruled lines on the baselines, a drawn resize handle and a character counter.

files.content:
import { defineRecipe } from '@/lib/ink/recipes'
import { drawFieldFrame } from '@/lib/ink/recipes/field-frame-ink'

export interface TextareaParams {
  disabled?: boolean
  invalid?: boolean
  readOnly?: boolean
  ruled?: boolean
  lineHeight?: number
  ruleTop?: number
  grip?: boolean
}

export const textareaRecipe = defineRecipe<TextareaParams>({
  id: 'textarea',
  kind: 'field',
  layers: ['rest', 'hover', 'focus', 'invalid', 'disabled'],
  lazy: ['focus', 'hover'],
  pad: 12,
  draw(ink, box, params, ctx) {
    drawFieldFrame(ink, box, { ...params, multiline: true }, ctx)
  },
})

a11y: A native <textarea>: Enter adds a line, Tab moves on, and label / aria-describedby / required work as usual.
aria-invalid, disabled and readOnly are the real attributes; the drawing follows them.
Focus draws the blue felt ring; the browser's outline is used before the drawing exists and in Windows high contrast.
The counter is aria-describedby text ("12 characters of 280"), never a live region.
Resizing uses the browser's own handle (made transparent and redrawn by hand), so it keeps working with the mouse and touch.
field-sizing: content needs a current browser; elsewhere the textarea keeps its rows and scrolls.
